what_is_it.explanation: VibeStart is a tool that allows developers to compose a full-stack TypeScript stack for AI coding agents, providing a project structure with built-in type safety, linting, and tests. It helps prevent codebase erosion over time by giving agents a consistent structure, an AGENTS.md guide, and rapid feedback checks. Projects are generated as ordinary repositories with no runtime dependency on VibeStart.
